items.title: Establish forge_session package, thin shim, bundling gates; extract topology.py as pilot
items.description:
Create the scripts/forge_session/ package and prove the whole extraction mechanism on ONE self-contained cluster (the backlog-topology verb), leaving all other code in place.

STEPS:
1. Create scripts/forge_session/__init__.py (package marker; may hold a module docstring).
2. Create scripts/forge_session/_common.py and MOVE into it the low-level primitives that later modules will share: the TypedDicts/exceptions (FeatureRow, EpicReconcile, StageExitDirectives, StageExitPayload, VerifyEntry, UsageError) and the shared readers topology needs (at minimum load_json_with_duplicates, warn_duplicate_keys, and any small helper cmd_backlog_topology/_load_topology_items call). Only move what is actually shared; leave everything else in the shim body for now.
3. Create scripts/forge_session/topology.py and MOVE the topology cluster into it: _id_key, _build_dep_index, _transitive_dependents, _max_chain_depth, _normalize_reason, _jaccard, cluster_blocked, compute_topology, cmd_backlog_topology, _load_topology_items, _print_topology. It imports shared primitives FROM scripts.forge_session._common — NEVER from the shim (that would be circular).
4. Rewrite scripts/forge-session.py as a thin shim that (a) inserts its own directory on sys.path so `import forge_session` resolves even when the file is loaded by path, then (b) re-exports every public and private symbol the rest of the code and the tests reference (e.g. `from forge_session._common import *`, `from forge_session.topology import *`, and keep the remaining not-yet-extracted definitions inline). The shim MUST still define/expose main() and end with `if __name__ == "__main__": raise SystemExit(main())` exactly as today.
5. Bundling: in scripts/build-adapters.py, RUNTIME_HELPERS lists single files — make the build copy the ENTIRE scripts/forge_session/ directory into every bundle alongside forge-session.py, and extend the byte-identical helper assertion to cover the package files. In scripts/forge-root.sh, add the package to CORE_ASSETS (or its completeness gate) so the self-contained-bundle check still passes.
6. Regenerate adapters with the yaml venv: .venv-adapters/bin/python scripts/build-adapters.py, then run the adapter --check to confirm no drift.

CRITICAL INVARIANTS: verb names, flags, exit codes, and JSON shapes are frozen. Tests load scripts/forge-session.py by path via importlib spec_from_file_location and read symbols directly off the loaded module (e.g. fs._id_key, fs.compute_topology) AND shell out to it as a CLI — both paths must keep working with ZERO test edits.
7. STRUCTURAL-GUARD EVOLUTION (design-approved 2026-09-07): introducing the forge_session/ package is the whole point of this item, but tests/test_build_adapters.py::test_no_new_file_appears_under_an_adapter_scripts_dir asserts each bundle's scripts/ holds EXACTLY the flat RUNTIME_HELPERS and NO directory. Evolve THAT ONE test (only) so it permits the known package dir(s) while STILL failing on stray/unexpected entries: assert the emitted top-level dir names equal the generator's new RUNTIME_HELPER_DIRS tuple (e.g. `assert sorted(d.name for d in scripts_dir.iterdir() if d.is_dir()) == sorted(mod.RUNTIME_HELPER_DIRS)`), keeping the existing files==RUNTIME_HELPERS assertion intact. Do NOT touch any other test, and do NOT relax the CLI-contract tests (verb names/flags/exit codes/JSON stay frozen).
acceptanceCriteria: scripts/forge_session/ exists with __init__.py, _common.py, and topology.py; the topology functions listed above live in topology.py and are gone from the shim body.
scripts/forge-session.py is a shim that inserts its own dir on sys.path and re-exports the package symbols; it still exposes main() and the `if __name__ == "__main__"` entry.
No package module imports from the shim (no circular import); shared primitives are imported from forge_session._common.

scripts/build-adapters.py copies the whole scripts/forge_session/ dir into every bundle and the byte-identical helper assertion covers the package; scripts/forge-root.sh CORE_ASSETS/completeness gate includes the package.
Adapters regenerated (.venv-adapters/bin/python scripts/build-adapters.py) and the adapter --check reports no drift.
tests/test_backlog_topology.py passes unmodified (it path-loads forge-session.py and reads topology symbols off it).
python3 scripts/forge-session.py doctor --json exits 0 (CHECK-I21 smoke).

bash scripts/validate.sh passes; the ONLY permitted test edit is evolving test_no_new_file_appears_under_an_adapter_scripts_dir to admit the forge_session/ package dir via RUNTIME_HELPER_DIRS (all other test files unmodified; CLI-contract tests untouched).

test_no_new_file_appears_under_an_adapter_scripts_dir still FAILS on a stray/unexpected file or directory under adapters/<agent>/scripts/ (it admits only RUNTIME_HELPERS files and RUNTIME_HELPER_DIRS dirs, not arbitrary ones).
items.notes: This is the load-bearing item — it proves shim re-export + sys.path + bundling + smoke on a small surface before the bulk moves. Gotcha: path-loading does NOT put scripts/ on sys.path, so the shim must add it itself before importing forge_session. Gotcha: `pytest tests` (validate.sh's scoped run) is authoritative; a bare-root pytest collects 7 forge-bootstrap/.../templates/python/tests/test_smoke.py scaffolding files that error unrelated. Lays the groundwork for 002-008. [2026-09-07 design decision: the flat-bundle structural guard conflicted with the package-dir bundling this item introduces; approved to evolve that single guard test (criterion 8 relaxed accordingly). Frozen CLI contract (verbs/flags/exit/JSON) unchanged.]
